EXAMPLE 1
Actual partner (evaluation only): Person B
================================================================================

EXACT PROMPT GIVEN TO MODEL:
You are generating dialogue as Person A.

Study the examples to learn Person A's general communication
style and how it may vary depending on the person they are
speaking with.

Use the examples to guide your response, while responding
naturally to the current conversation.

Generate exactly one response from Person A.
Do not explain your reasoning or include a speaker label.

EXAMPLES:
Example — Person A and Person C
Person A: So, how was your date?
Person C: Well, y'know how I always wanted to go out with Person D in high school?
Person A: Um-hmm.
Person C: Well, tonight, I actually went out with Person D in high school.
Person A: Oh honey, I'm sorry.

Example — Person A and Person B
Person A: Oh yeah, no, what's that?
Person B: If like the four of us could all y'know, hang out together. Uh, in fact Person E's coming into town this weekend, why don't you say we all have dinner? Say, Sunday night?
Person A: That would be great!
Person B: Yeah, all right, it's a date.
Person A: Hang in there. You hang in there.
Person B: Did you say something?
Person A: No, just singing.

Example — Person A and Person C
Person A: So, how was your date?
Person C: Well, y'know how I always wanted to go out with Person D in high school?
Person A: Um-hmm.
Person C: Well, tonight, I actually went out with Person D in high school.
Person A: Oh honey, I'm sorry.
Person C: No, it's okay, not only did I get to go out with Person D, I got to dump Person D.
Person A: Ohh! That's so great!

Example — Person A and Person B
Person B: Person A? You wanna come?
Person A: Oh no, I can't. I got a date.
Person B: A date?
Person A: Yeah. Why? Is that weird for you?

NEW CONVERSATION:
Person A: Where ya going?
[Other Person]: Oh, I've got to go pick up Person D, we've got a play date this afternoon.
Person A: Ohh, with who?
[Other Person]: Oh, just this woman that I met last night at the party.

Person A:

GOLD RESPONSE:
There was a woman at the... The stripper?!

GENERATED RESPONSE:
That's exciting! Have a great time.
